covariance.G: players contributing positive-FTA rows (835 primary); 22 zero-only players retain accounting/bootstrap membership but contribute no scores

rank_policy: Fixed global original-level dummy coding and reference throughout bootstrap. Drop only nonidentifiable columns using deterministic ordered modified Gram-Schmidt, twice reorthogonalized, relative norm cutoff 1e-10. Intercept/exposure/height must survive. No levels pooled; absent/reference aliases removed only as numerical basis reduction. Log all dropped columns.

bootstrap.zero_rows: all seasons retained in copied accounting; positive rows only for fit
bootstrap.fit: actual duplicated grouped rows; exact fixed design; no Bernoulli expansion
bootstrap.failure: log error and retain replicate number; never replace; stop interpretation if >20 failures

sensitivities.J2: Exact Stage 2 fit_bb including analytic likelihood, 3 starts kappa=10,50,200, L-BFGS-B, maxiter=3000, score<1e-3, all starts accepted/agreement 1e-5, positive information and Hessian stability; per-replicate grouped GLM start; no model change; bootstrap seed 20260931
sensitivities.J3: Earliest chronological eligible accounting season per player, selected before filtering FTA=0; HC1=N/(N-K) on independent row scores
sensitivities.J4: Let T_i count all primary accounting seasons, including zero-FTA seasons, and w_it=1/T_i. J4 maximizes sum_it w_it log Binomial(FTM_it | FTA_it, expit(X_it beta)). The grouped response remains [FTM, FTA-FTM]; fractional likelihood weights do not turn counts into fractional trials. Score s_it=w_it X_it(FTM_it-FTA_it p_it); information=sum w_it FTA_it p_it(1-p_it) X_it X_it^T. Cluster meat sums these weighted scores by player before outer products. statsmodels freq_weights implements this powered likelihood; independent score/Hessian checks validate it. The CR1 correction uses actual positive rows and contributing players, not sum(weights). Equal aggregate season weights precede unequal FTA precision; total player information is not equalized.
sensitivities.J5: Each of 13 seasons omitted once; unchanged J1 and CR1; fixed rank policy
sensitivities.alternate_units: advantage per inch; ratio raw per 1.0 and additional per .01 scale
sensitivities.full: Exact full frozen panel with 2013-14, after primary freeze; CR1; not independent replication

ordering: protocol + hash -> implementation tests -> J1 + CR1 + 2000 bootstrap -> immutable primary_result + receipt -> every sensitivity
estimand: Conditional population-average association among observed measured player-seasons adjusted for barefoot height, original combine position and season; attempt-weighted through grouped denominator; time-invariant exposure identified between players.

interpretation.magnitude: coefficient and exp(beta) per residual inch, not percentage points
interpretation.precision: both cluster Wald and percentile intervals, descriptive p; significance not execution criterion
interpretation.stability: report every predeclared analysis sign/magnitude without composite score or selection
interpretation.comparison: Stage 1/2 descriptive comparison only after primary freeze; development season excluded from primary
interpretation.opportunity: Free-throw attempt volume is the grouped-binomial denominator rather than an accuracy predictor. Earlier analyses demonstrated informative opportunity and predictive misspecification or weak posterior identification. This simpler conditional association does not model the opportunity data-generating process or resolve that limitation.
interpretation.clustering: Dependence adjustment does not control unmeasured player ability, training, role, selection, NBA survival, combine participation or informative opportunity.
interpretation.selection: Measured players are selected; reuse approved coverage table; no FT%-based recalculation

diagnostics.summary: pooled observed rate=sum FTM/sum FTA; fitted=sum FTA*p/sum FTA; residual=observed-fitted, overall/bins/seasons; min/max and counts p<.01 or >.99
diagnostics.use: transparency only; no generative PPC gate or modification

historical_trace_policy: Hash bytes only; do not decode old Stage 3C/H/I scientific coefficients
